:::{#thm-constant-prediction-decompose}
#### Expected squared error of a constant prediction

Let $Y$ be a random variable with mean $\mean$ and finite variance.
Then for every number $c$,

$$
\E{\sqf{Y - c}} = \Var{Y} + \sqf{\mean - c}.
$$ {#eq-constant-prediction-decompose}

:::

::: proof

Add and subtract $\mean$ inside the square,
expand it,
and take the expectation term by term:

$$
\ba
\E{\sqf{Y - c}}
&= \E{\sqf{(Y - \mean) + (\mean - c)}}
&& \text{(add and subtract } \mean \text{)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{Y - \mean} + 2(\mean - c)(Y - \mean) + \sqf{\mean - c}}
&& \text{(expand the square of a sum)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{Y - \mean}} + 2(\mean - c)\E{Y - \mean} + \sqf{\mean - c}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation; } \mean \text{ and } c \text{ are constants)} \\
&= \Var{Y} + 2(\mean - c)\E{Y - \mean} + \sqf{\mean - c}
&& \text{(variance as expected squared deviation)} \\
&= \Var{Y} + 2(\mean - c) \cdot 0 + \sqf{\mean - c}
&& \text{(} \E{Y - \mean} = \E{Y} - \mean = 0 \text{)} \\
&= \Var{Y} + \sqf{\mean - c}
&& \text{(zero times a number)}
\ea
$$

:::
